messages:
maria: Heads up - canary replay shows perf divergence after KV warmup, p95 spikes on new kernel.
kevin: numbers?
maria: baseline: p50 8.9ms p95 27.5ms kv_hit 0.912. new-kernel: p50 12.1ms p95 48.6ms kv_hit 0.776. divergence ~after token 800.
sam: harness config identical (seed/anonymize)? even small sampling diffs break apples-to-apples.
maria: yes same seed + scrub. cohort ids match; request shapes identical.
anita: recent kernel-picker change (commit a3f4c9) might route some ops to the new GEMM path.
kevin: try forcing legacy selector: kernel_override=legacy and rerun.
maria: launching: `./scripts/replay/run.sh --trace 2104 --cohort brief --seed 42 --kernel-override legacy --prewarm=true`
perf-bot: queued replay/2104/2799991234. est 10m.
kevin: set BATCHING_DEBUG=1 so we can see batch composition.
sam: also add `--kv-trace` to capture per-step hit/miss timeline.
anita: hypothesis: new kernel increases per-op latency for short sequences; with lower kv hits we see amplified tails.
maria: legacy run done: p50 9.1ms p95 29.8ms kv_hit 0.905. new-kernel w/ legacy selector: p50 9.9 p95 31.2 kv_hit 0.894. selector matters.
kevin: binary search selector thresholds to find which shapes flip.
sam: runbook: 1) same trace+seed+scrub 2) capture batch traces + kv traces 3) run kernel_override legacy/new 4) bisect kernel_picker_threshold 5) collect logits sha256 per request for parity.
anita: add step 6: op-level perf from perf-prof, flag ops >5% regression.
maria: note scrub must preserve request ordering; anonymization that reorders will invalidate parity.
kevin: also check cohort slicing logic: off-by-one in slice calculation bit us before.
maria: added verify script: `scripts/replay/verify_determinism.py --trace 2104 --seed 42` - it compares sha256 of logits and top-1.
sam: paste verify output for new-kernel mismatch.
maria: VERIFY START trace=2104 seed=42
runA: sha256=3b8f9c1d...
runB: sha256=7d2aa1ff...  <-- mismatch at token 837
kevin: mismatch aligns with kv hit drop. inspect kv warmup eviction timeline around token 800-900.
anita: check prefill->kv_insert path; there was a prior race fix that might regress if scheduling changes.
maria: instrumented kv_insert micro-timing.
perf-bot: micro-run results: kv_insert avg legacy 0.22ms, new-kernel 0.43ms.
sam: doubled kv_insert explains lower hit rate and earlier evictions.
kevin: mitigation options: tune batch sizes, increase kv capacity/ttl, revert selector tweak, or optimize kv_insert for new kernel.
anita: prefer scoped rollback of selector tweak + perf task to optimize insert path.
maria: filing ticket with artifacts and exact repro commands.
maria: ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RINF-1428 includes runs, batch traces, kv traces, sha diffs.
sam: add a small nightly parity job (1k-token trace) to catch regressions early before merges.
kevin: agree. schedule deep debug session tomorrow 11:00. i'll start rolling back selector tweak on canary.
maria: will post follow-up with commands and artifacts. :thumbsup:
